diagram_previews.alt: Equilateral triangle ABC with side BC labelled 8. Inside it, three grey congruent squares sit on the sides of a small downward-pointing equilateral triangle, and each side of ABC passes through two outer corners of the squares.

Equilateral triangle ABC containing a small downward-pointing equilateral triangle with grey squares on its three sides. The bottom vertex D of the small triangle has a 120 degree gap between two squares, whose outer corners P1 and P2 lie on BC. Along BC the pieces are labelled x, x times root 3 and x. Q is the corner of the right square on AC, and the 60 degree angle at P2 between BC and the square's side P2Q is marked.
